commands: set -eu; LABEL=com.michal.local-agent-v4111-bootstrap; echo '=== BEFORE ==='; launchctl print "gui/$(id -u)/$LABEL" 2>&1 | head -n 20 || true; launchctl remove "$LABEL" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 2; echo '=== AFTER ==='; launchctl print "gui/$(id -u)/$LABEL" 2>&1 | head -n 20 || true; echo '=== MAIN SUPERVISOR ==='; launchctl print "gui/$(id -u)/com.michal.local-agent" | grep -E 'state =|pid ='; echo '=== STATUS ==='; cat "$HOME/Library/Application Support/local-agent/status.json"
